description: Machine-readable classification of the coarse `jsonrpc` TCK failing bucket (docs/tck-history.json: jsonrpc 12/75 as of 2026-06-11) into the five stable sub-categories named in a2a-nexus#1500. This is the structural layer the promotion protocol consumes: a category can only be promoted to a blocking gate once it is tracked here AND confirmed green across a stable measurement window (see docs/a2a-tck-runbook.md).

derivedFrom: packages/broker/src/a2a/json-rpc.ts (current code status of the A2A error family)
provenance.limits: Sub-category pass/total counts are NOT independently measured: the harness (scripts/append-tck-history.mjs) only emits coarse directory buckets (agent_card, jsonrpc, http_json, grpc), so per-sub-category numbers require a per-test node-id -> sub-category emission that does not exist yet. Fields below record ROOT CAUSE and CURRENT CODE STATUS only; `measuredPassTotal` is null until the harness emits sub-category granularity. Nothing here asserts conformance beyond the committed coarse baseline.
